headline: Sufficiently Strict Sanctions to Prevent Unemployment Insurance Evasion
summary: Vietnamese inspectors say strict sanctions are in place to prevent unemployment insurance evasion. Article 46 of Decree 283/2026 sets penalty levels, effective from September 10, 2026.
why: Unemployment insurance contributions fund worker benefits and affect employers' payroll costs. Enforcement changes can affect labour compliance for businesses.
